name: Ethena USDtb
oneLiner: USDtb is Ethena's T-Bill-backed stablecoin, holding BlackRock's BUIDL fund as primary reserves; designed as a calmer alternative to USDe.
collateral: ~90% BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL), investing in cash, U.S. Treasury Bills/Notes, and repurchase agreements; remainder in cash or cash-equivalent redemption reserves; issued by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A.; U.S. Bank acts as reserve custodian
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption; BUIDL shares redeemable 24/7 via atomic swap with Securitize; LayerZero OFT cross-chain transfers

proofOfReserves.provider: Big Four accounting firm via Anchorage Digital Bank
